title: festuca pumila var. varia
intro: Festuca pumila var. varia, commonly known as alpine fescue or snow grass, is a low-growing, perennial grass species found in mountainous regions. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system, thereby offering potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of alpine fescue include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can aid in relieving respiratory issues and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
